source.title: Reshii Hood - Wowhead PTR item Quick Facts

notes: The War Within patch 11.2.0 Reshii Regalia head cosmetic appearance. Wowhead PTR Quick Facts explicitly marks this exact item ID as non-disenchantable; the live item page (https://www.wowhead.com/item=247703/reshii-hood) identifies it as a cosmetic appearance, and the 2025-08-26 Wowhead article https://www.wowhead.com/news/final-upgrade-and-transmog-pieces-reshii-wraps-upgraded-to-rank-6-378334 confirms both appearances come from the final Reshii Wraps upgrade. Newly source-linked v3 evidence (GitHub code search found the ID in preexisting DB2Restrictions.lua but no existing war-within evidence). Not an in-game current-Retail eligibility test. Does NOT supply any disenchant yield, rank, operation count, price or numeric baseline.
